segments: A woman waited ten years for her boyfriend's inheritance. Then she poisoned him.
Ina and Steven had been together a decade in North Dakota, when an email said he'd inherited thirty million dollars.
The day he went to meet the lawyer, Ina laced his sweet tea with antifreeze.
He died two days later. Police searched for the thirty million dollars he'd supposedly inherited.
They never found it. There was no inheritance, no lawyer -- just a scam email two people believed completely.
She's now serving twenty five years, for killing a man over a fortune that never existed. Follow for more true stories.

metadata.title: Random But True: She Poisoned Her Boyfriend For A $30 Million Inheritance
metadata.caption:
A North Dakota woman poisoned her boyfriend of ten years, believing she'd share in a $30 million inheritance he was about to receive.

Police searched for that fortune after his death. What they found instead changes the entire story.

Follow for more true crime stories that sound too strange to be real.
